description: This Dart source file defines the AppState class, which manages global application state related to authentication token persistence, user login status, and initialization status. It uses SharedPreferences for persistence and extends ChangeNotifier for state change notifications in Flutter.

classes.name: AppState
classes.description: Manages global application state such as authentication token, initialization status, and provides methods for initialization, persistence, and clearing of the token.

methods.name: token
methods.description: Returns the current authentication or JWT token if available.

methods.name: isLoggedIn
methods.description: Indicates whether the user is currently considered logged in based on the presence of a valid token.

methods.name: initialised
methods.description: Indicates whether the app state has completed initialization.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes app state by loading persisted values like the auth token from SharedPreferences.

methods.name: setToken
methods.description: Persists the provided auth token and updates the application state.

methods.name: logout
methods.description: Clears the auth token from state and persistent storage, effectively logging out the user.
